description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Awoken Monk], [Damage Cap +10000] to the user, grants [Instant Cast 1]/[Instant Cast 1] and [Weakness +15% Boost (15s)]/[Instant Cast 1] and [Weakness +30% Boost (15s)] to the user/all allies/all allies if 0-1/2-3/4+ FF4 allies are alive
